edition_headline: Food-assistance providers report rising demand across Los Angeles, North Carolina and North Texas

items.headline: Los Angeles provider reports CalFresh-related demand strain
items.summary: The Los Angeles Times reported that Food Access Los Angeles Executive Director Jennifer Grissom attributed part of increased food-assistance demand in Los Angeles County to changes in CalFresh work requirements.
items.card_summary: The Los Angeles Times reported that Grissom attributed part of increased food-assistance demand in Los Angeles County to changes in CalFresh work requirements.
items.glance_label: Los Angeles County: A provider attributed part of increased food-assistance demand to changes in CalFresh work requirements.
items.why_it_matters: A named provider's observation supports a bounded demand-strain signal for Los Angeles County.
items.uncertainty_note: The cited passage does not quantify the increase or support a uniform countywide effect.

items.headline: Food Bank leaders report increased emergency-food demand across North Carolina
items.summary: ABC11 reported that Food Bank leaders attributed increased demand for emergency food assistance across North Carolina to benefit losses and rising food costs.
items.card_summary: ABC11 reported that Food Bank leaders attributed increased demand for emergency food assistance across North Carolina to benefit losses and rising food costs.
items.glance_label: North Carolina: Food Bank leaders attributed increased emergency-food demand to benefit losses and rising food costs.
items.why_it_matters: The reported increase in emergency-food demand supports a current statewide food-access pressure signal.
items.uncertainty_note: The cited passage does not provide a demand total, comparison period, or separate measure for any city or county.

items.headline: North Texas food banks report demand strain as charitable-food reliance rises
items.summary: KERA News reported that food banks serving the North Texas Food Bank and Tarrant Area Food Bank regions were under increased strain as reliance on charitable food assistance rose.
items.card_summary: KERA News reported that food banks serving the North Texas Food Bank and Tarrant Area Food Bank regions were under increased strain as reliance on charitable food assistance rose.
items.glance_label: North Texas: KERA News reported demand strain in the North Texas Food Bank and Tarrant Area Food Bank service regions as charitable-food reliance rose.
items.archive_label: North Texas food-bank service-region demand strain
items.why_it_matters: The reported condition supports a demand-strain signal bounded to the two named food-bank service regions.
items.uncertainty_note: The cited passage does not quantify current demand growth, establish a uniform condition throughout both service regions, or show service reduction or unmet need.
